excerpt.zh:
没有他们不敢面对的挑战，没有他们不愿追逐的线索，也没有他们会视若罔闻的风暴。

从本质上来说，这是一个追求刺激的文明。即有好处也有坏处。
excerpt.en:
There is no challenge they will not face, no lead they'll fail to chase - and no storm they will ignore.

At its core, this is a civilization seeking thrills. To its benefit, and to its detriment.

label.zh: 浩宇风暴是我们的终极宿命！
label.en: The Big One is our ultimate destiny!

label.zh: 算了，我们可以做得更好！
label.en: No, we are better than this!
We need to save up some resources.
We need to save up some resources.

从本质上来说，这是一个追求刺激的文明。即有好处也有坏处。
texts.en:
There is no challenge they will not face, no lead they'll fail to chase - and no storm they will ignore.

At its core, this is a civilization seeking thrills. To its benefit, and to its detriment.

sections.zh:
无奔波不生活。生于灿烂，死于热烈——这一直以来就是我们的信条。当每条航迹都被燃尽，每座山峰都被攀登，然后呢？

我们的行星常年风起云涌，各种风暴和洪水肆意挥洒。如果能找到利用这些独特条件的方法，我们就有机会召唤一场狂暴的宇宙风暴。

我们早就已经征服了母星上的一切挑战，是时候尖啸着飞向深空了。这当然不会是一条坦途，但我们有一句老话：“有志者，惊事成！”
sections.en:
What's life without the rush? Burn fast and die radically - that's always been our way. But when every trail is blazed and even the tallest peak is scaled, what next?

Our planet has always been a stormy one, prone to tempests and deluges of all kinds. If we find ways to use these unique conditions, we have a chance to summon a raging cosmic storm.

Our legendary forebears long since mastered the challenges of our homeworld. The time has come to blast off screaming into the void. It will not be easy, but as the old saying goes, "Only the bold can reach the horizon."

texts.zh:
我们发现这颗彗星实际上是一个巨大的巢穴，里面充斥着微小的昆虫。彗尾也不是冰雾，而是巢穴内部化学反应所排放的废气。

巢穴的外壳由死亡的昆虫组成，这使得内部生的物免受太空恶劣环境的影响。我们还发现了几种依附于巢穴生活的真菌。巢穴中存在一种复杂的共生关系，真菌依赖排放的废气维生，而昆虫则以真菌为食。
texts.en:
The comet was revealed to be a giant nest filled with tiny insects. The tail of the comet is not outgassed ice, but rather exhaust from chemical processes occurring deep inside the hive.

The outer layer of the nest is composed of dead individuals, protecting the living inside from the harsh conditions of space. We've also picked up several types of fungi living in and around the nest. There is a complex symbiosis at work here, with the fungi living off of the exhaust gasses and the insects feeding on the fungi.

texts.zh:
这是我们始料未及的发现：大脑集群。来自各种物种的湿糊糊的有机处理器官，成百上千个地连接在一起，悬浮在一个气球状的大型胶囊之中。它似乎已经被废弃，在近期的虚境风暴消散之后飘浮在深空之中。

胶囊之中有一个惊人的传感器阵列连接在大脑和胶囊之上，此外还有一个通信模块，能够呼叫舰船并发送信息，之前它对我们就是这么做的。

现在看来似乎是这些大脑自己联系了我们，解释了那一连串的信息。我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]认为这个装置的初衷是测试有机体对虚境风暴的反应。考虑到这些悬浮大脑内不稳定的残留灵能，尝试与其连接可能会带来危险。
texts.en:
We could never have anticipated our discovery: brains. Organic, squishy central processing organs from all sorts of species. Hundreds and hundreds of them, all linked together and suspended inside a large balloon-like capsule. It appears to be derelict, left floating in the depths of space after a recent Shroud Storm dissipated.

The capsule contains an incredible array of sensors attached to the brains and the balloon, and there is also a communication module, capable of hailing ships and transmitting information, just as it did to us.

It seems likely that the brains themselves contacted us, explaining the cacophony of messages. Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] think the construction was designed to measure organic responses to a Shroud Storm. Given the unstable psionic residue within these floating minds, attempting to interface them would only lead to disaster.

texts.zh:
[Root.Owner.GetScientistPluralCapital]报告称这个空间站的大部分是由常见的固定材料建成的，这些物质勉强维持着空间站不至于散架。随着我们深入这座结构，构成空间站的物质从金属合金过渡成了塑料等其他材料。

在空间站的核心处，我们发现了一台机器正在高效运转，它不断地拆解有机原料并将其转化为我们之前见到的东西。

在运行DNA模拟模型后，我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]只能得出结论，这些原料可能是空间站的前住民。
texts.en:
[Root.Owner.GetScientistPluralCapital] report that much of this space station is constructed from everyday stationary objects, barely holding it together. Deeper into the structure, the materials transition from metal alloys to plastics and other substances.

Inside the heart of the construct we found a machine, still in the process of efficiently deconstructing organic material and shaping it into the very items encountered so far.

After running a DNA simulation model, our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] have been forced to conclude that the material likely came from the former inhabitants of this outpost.

label.zh: 看看我们能发现些什么。
label.en: See if we can't gain something here.

texts.zh:
[root.leader.GetName]汇报了自[from.GetAffectedStormType]过境以来，[From.GetStarName]的聚变反应所发生的奇妙变化。

显然，这个风暴引发了恒星内核某种意想不到的核反应，导致其对流区稳定地释放出[from.GetEarnedResources]。

这些复杂而特殊的反应产生了我们所观察到的这些不寻常的多色闪光。无论如何，在一段时间内这的都会一直是一个值得仔细研究的来源。
texts.en:
[root.leader.GetName] reports fascinating changes in [From.GetStarName]'s fusion reactions since the passage of the [from.GetAffectedStormType].

It appears that the storm induced unexpected nuclear reactions within the star's core, resulting in a steady release of [from.GetEarnedResources] from its convective zones.

These complex and idiosyncratic reactions are producing the unusual polychromatic flaring we have observed. In any case, it will continue to be a source worthy of close study for some time.

texts.zh:
[root.leader.GetName]发现，沉积于[from.solar_system.GetName]星系的小行星具有高度不稳定的磁性质，导致它们在恒星系中现有的磁层上发生随机的弹跳。

[root.leader.GetName]通过给每个小行星施加磁场补偿器进行了稳定，使其轨道规范化并使其便于进行资源开采。
texts.en:
[root.leader.GetName] discovered that the asteroids deposited in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system possess highly unstable magnetic fields, causing them to ricochet haphazardly off the system's existing magnetospheres.

[root.leader.GetName] stabilized them by adding magnetic compensators to each asteroid, regulating their trajectories and thus making them amenable to resource extraction efforts.

texts.zh:
我们已经确定了[from.solar_system.GetName]星系中遇险信号的来源，那一艘严重受损但仍在运作的商船。

乘员声称他们被[from.GetAffectedStormType]撞离了航线很远。风暴也烧毁了他们的引擎，让飞船和里面的东西滞留在我们的空间里。

如果我们能帮忙的话，他们愿意交出一部分货物。
texts.en:
We have identified the source of the distress signal in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system as a heavily damaged but still functioning mercantile vessel.

The occupants claim they have been knocked a great distance off course by the [from.GetAffectedStormType]. The storm has also burnt out their engines, leaving the ship and its contents stranded in our space.

They are willing to part with a portion of their cargo if we can help.

label.zh: 夺走他们的生命以及货物。

texts.zh:
[from.solar_system.GetName]星系内的异常读数源自一片由[from.GetAffectedStormType]的余波所残留下的不寻常的碎片阵列。

这个漂浮的实体是由一团无定形的宇宙污泥在风暴的极端压力下锻造而成。它的无数组成元素形成了一种独特的活性化合物。

对其化学成分的深度研究可以对产生它的条件提供有价值的星际气象学洞见。
texts.en:
The erratic sensor readings in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system are derived from an exceptional debris formation left in the wake of the [from.GetAffectedStormType].

This drifting entity is an amorphous blob of cosmic sludge, forged in the extreme pressures of the storm. Its innumerable constituent elements have formed a uniquely reactive compound.

Focused study of its chemistry could yield valuable astrometeorological insights into the conditions that produced it.

texts.zh:
[from.solar_system.GetName]星系中的物体是一颗古老人造卫星的残骸，上面装有复杂的星际气象探测阵列。我们认为它是伴随着[from.GetAffectedStormType]横跨星系漂星过海而来的。

它已严重损坏无法维修，但中央数据库包含了大量的信息贮藏可以为我们所用。

卫星的其余部分就只能作为废品进行打捞了。
texts.en:
The object in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system is the wreckage of an ancient satellite equipped with complex astrometeorological sensor arrays. We believe that it was swept a great distance across the galaxy in the wake of the [from.GetAffectedStormType].

Now damaged beyond repair, its central databases contain a vast store of information that we can repurpose for our own needs.

The rest of the satellite is only salvageable as scrap.

texts.zh: 我们发现，[from.solar_system.GetName]星系的怪异物体其实是一大团来自某种太空生物的有机残留物。由于所有可供识别的特征都被宇宙风暴撕碎了，所以无法对这些生物碎片进行准确分类。
texts.en: The foreign object in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system was discovered to be a large mass of organic remains originating from some type of spaceborne fauna. Having had any identifiable features shredded apart by the cosmic storm, it is impossible to correctly catalog the biological debris.

texts.zh: 幸运的是，大部分仍可食用。
texts.en: Fortunately, it remains mostly edible.

texts.zh: [leader.GetName]确信，对该生物遗骸进行更详细的法医分析将揭示更多有关其起源性质的信息，以及[from.GetAffectedStormType]对类似太空生物的影响。
texts.en: [leader.GetName] is confident that a more detailed forensic analysis of the creature's remains would reveal more information about the nature of its origins and the effects of a [from.GetAffectedStormType] on similar space faring organisms.

texts.zh:
经过了谨慎的解剖，这团肉块究竟属于什么物种仍是个谜。在风暴中心遭受的巨大破坏使它失去了一切可供识别的特征和遗传标记。

然而，在这项研究的过程中，我们获得了对宇宙风暴组成的洞见，了解了其对外星生物质的破坏性影响。
texts.en:
After careful dissection, the original species of this visceral mass remains a mystery. The extraordinary damage taken in the epicenter of the storm has stripped it of any recognizable features or genetic markers.

However, in the process of this study we have gained insight into the composition of Cosmic Storms and their devastating effects on xenobiological matter.

texts.zh:
[solar_system.GetName]星系内的三只缇扬奇信号经过识别后发现是一伙流离失所、营养不良的幼崽。

宇宙风暴将这些幼崽与它们的大群分开，迫使他们自力更生。

它们看来不太可能在幽深的太空中存活太久。我们的传感器显示它们整在试图呼叫鲸群，但没有成功。
texts.en:
The three Tiyanki signatures in the [solar_system.GetName] system have been identified as a set of displaced and malnourished calves.

The Cosmic Storm has separated these calves from their larger pod, leaving them to fend for themselves.

They are unlikely to survive for long in open space. Our sensors show they are attempting to call for their pod but are having no success.

texts.zh: 我们的通讯系统可以用来增强它们的呼救声，吸引它们的群体进入恒星系。
texts.en: Our communication systems could be used to boost their cries for help and attract their pod into the system.

texts.zh: 我们可以放大它们呼救的声音，把它们当作诱饵，引来一顿更大的大餐。
texts.en: We could boost their cries for help and use them as bait to draw in a larger feast.

texts.zh:
缇扬奇的成兽在听到了三只幼崽被放大的叫声后，再度现身在[solar_system.GetName]星系中。

年轻的缇扬奇重新回到了鲸群，现在已经恢复了快乐和健康。

母鲸在我们的科研船附近留下了一大堆物质碎片，似乎是在感谢我们的帮助。令我们惊讶的是，这件奇怪的礼物中包含了好几种可用的材料。
texts.en:
A Tiyanki cow and bull have both appeared in the [solar_system.GetName] system having heard the amplified cries of the three displaced calves.

The juvenile Tiyanki have been reintegrated back into their pod, and already appear much happier and healthier.

The cow has deposited a large mass of debris near our science vessel, seemingly as some kind of appreciation for our assistance. To our surprise this curious offering contains several usable materials.

texts.zh: 当然，这些大东西才是真正的猎物；我们已经准备好猎杀了。
texts.en: Of course, these larger beasts are the true prize; primed and ready for the slaughter.

texts.zh:
尽管这座轨道复合体被宇宙风暴拖拽着漂星过海，但它似乎没怎么受到损伤。我们发现居住站中的居住和商业空间几乎状态完好。这些区域一尘不染，仿佛从未有人使用过一般。

在中控室中迎接我们的是一个令人眼花缭乱的输入系统：各种没有任何说明的刻度盘，设置不一的拉杆，大量的按钮以看似随机的间隔五颜六色地闪烁着。幸运的是，我们最终找到了一本手册。相信只要成功翻译出来，我们就可以重新激活这座居住站了。
texts.en:
Despite having been dragged across the galaxy by the cosmic storm, the orbital complex suffered very little harm. We found the living and commercial spaces of the habitat in almost perfect condition. Not a single bit of dust laid atop the surface that would betray a previous occupancy, as if it had never before been used.

Inside the central control hub we were greeted by a bewildering input system: dials with no explanation, levers with inconsistent settings and a great amount of buttons flashing a whole spectrum of colors at seemingly random intervals. Fortunately, we eventually came across a manual. Once this is successfully translated, we are confident we can reactivate the habitat.

texts.zh:
不幸的是，我们之前的估计过于乐观了：翻译出来的手册和这个控制系统一样令人无法理解。不仅缺失了一半的页面，图片说明上有着大量的符号学设定，而且另一半手册则是用一种难以破译的象形文字书写的。

然而，最后一页展示了一个通讯频率并附有一组可翻译成“帮助台”的字符。我们现在正尝试联络这个频率。
texts.en:
Unfortunately, our previous estimation appears to have been optimistic: the manual turned out to be just as incomprehensible as the control system. Half of the pages appeared to be missing and the pictorial instructions make significant semiotic assumptions. The other half of the manual is written in difficult to interpret hieroglyphs.

However, the last page displayed a com frequency accompanied by a set of characters translated to 'help desk'. We're attempting this frequency now.

title.zh: 您的来电对我们很重要
title.en: Your Call is Important To Us

texts.zh:
手册中的通讯频道连接到了一个名为“天空花园”的商业实体的帮助台主机。

助手人工智能用一种友好而中立的语气告诉我们，它感谢我们的联系，并询问是否有什么可以帮得上忙的。列出的选项包括“回答有关订阅的问题”、“了解新的智能防御系统”，以及我们是否希望更多地了解该公司的“社会责任倡议”。

然而，随后的选项把我们引向越来越不相关的话题。更糟的是，它还经常会让我们的[Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural]等待，然后切断通讯。显然，这个人工智能服务并没有像居住站的其他部分一样经受住时间的考验。

无论如何，我们将继续按自己的方法来试着搞定这个神秘的系统。
texts.en:
The manual's com frequency connected us to the help desk mainframe of a commercial entity known as Skygarden.

With a friendly though neutral tone, the help desk AI informed us that it appreciated our reaching out, and asked if there was anything it could aid us with. Among the listed options were 'answering questions about subscriptions', 'learning about the new line of smart defense systems' and if we wished to know more about the corporation's 'social responsibility initiatives'.

However, the subsequent options continued to direct us to entirely unrelated topics. Worse of all, it would often put our [Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural] on hold only to drop the call. Obviously, the service AI has not survived the passing of time as well as the rest of the habitat.

Nevertheless, we will continue trying to find our way through this arcane system.

texts.zh:
我们的[Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural]汇报，无论他们和人工智能说什么，在几分钟的等待过去后，这个系统都只会复读之前的内容。

我们尝试运行多个模拟来绘制精确的菜单树，但是却发生了递归错误，并且无法同时解决和检查解决方案。即使运行量子模型也没有得到理想的结果。我们怀疑在这个过程中我们不小心破坏了一些波函数。

我们不知所措了。
texts.en:
Our [Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural] report that regardless of what they said to the AI, after passing through several menus, the system would simply revert back to a previous statement.

We attempted to run several simulations to map out the exact menu tree, but our efforts returned recursive errors and an inability to both solve and check the solution at the same time. Even running a quantum model achieved no desirable results. We suspect we accidentally collapsed a few wave functions in the process.

We're at a loss.

label.zh: 告诉这个人工智能它的违禁词被违禁词了。
label.en: Tell the AI it's CENSORED and CENSORED.

texts.zh:
终于有进展了！这个人工智能警告我们用语不当，并告知我们应该等待客户服务代表的联系。

我们等了一阵子之后，通讯频道又打开了。另一端的实体介绍她自己为天空花园公司的记录管理员。服务台本身是她从上一位记录管理员那里继承来的人工智能程序。据她所知，自从几十年前天空花园破产以来，这个通讯站就再没有使用过了。当我们问她为什么继续为一个破产的机构工作时，她只说这就是她的合同内容。

向记录管理员阐明了我们的情况后，她翻出了一本古老的居住站快速入门指南。她很快就会把书页的数字印痕传送给我们。
texts.en:
Finally a breakthrough! The AI admonished us for using inappropriate language and stated we should wait until we are contacted by a customer service representative.

For a while we were left waiting, and then the com line was reopened. The entity on the other end introduced herself as the record keeper of the Skygarden Corporation. The help desk itself was an AI program she had inherited from the last record keeper. As far as she knows, the com station had not been used since the bankruptcy of Skygarden many decades ago. When we questioned why she remained working for a bankrupt organization, she simply said it was in her contract.

Explaining our situation, the record keeper dug up an old quick start guide to the habitat. She will transfer digital impressions of the pages to us soon.

texts.zh:
终于有进展了！这个人工智能显然对于我们长时间的沉默感到困惑不解，并将会把我们转给客服代表。

我们等了一阵子之后，通讯频道又打开了。另一端的实体介绍她自己为天空花园公司的记录管理员。服务台本身是她从上一位记录管理员那里继承来的人工智能程序。据她所知，自从几十年前天空花园破产以来，这个通讯站就再没有使用过了。当我们问她为什么继续为一个破产的机构工作时，她只说这就是她的合同内容。

向记录管理员阐明了我们的情况后，她翻出了一本古老的居住站快速入门指南。她很快就会把书页的数字印痕传送给我们。
texts.en:
Finally a breakthrough! The AI was apparently confused at our prolonged silence and will refer us to a customer service representative.

For a while we were left waiting, and then the com line was reopened. The entity on the other end introduced herself as the record keeper of the Skygarden Corporation. The help desk itself was an AI program she had inherited from the last record keeper. As far as she knows, the com station had not been used since the bankruptcy of Skygarden many decades ago. When we questioned why she remained working for a bankrupt organization, she simply said it was in her contract.

Explaining our situation, the record keeper dug up an old quick start guide to the habitat. She will transfer digital impressions of the pages to us soon.

For a while we were left waiting, and then the com line was reopened. The entity on the other end introduced herself as the record keeper of the Skygarden Corporation. The help desk itself was an AI program she had inherited from the last record keeper. As far as she knows, the com station had not been used since the bankruptcy of Skygarden many decades ago. When we questioned why she remained working for a bankrupt organization, she simply said it was in her contract.

Explaining our situation, the record keeper dug up an old quick start guide to the habitat. She will transfer digital impressions of the pages to us soon.

title.en: Years to Earn, Seconds to Lose

texts.zh:
有了新的指南后，重新启动居住站毫不费力。

在机器启动的声音慢慢平息后，我们决定再一次向记录员表示感谢。

她说在这个通讯台找到了一些信息，显然，这是五个多世纪前建造的原型，但在一场特别恶劣的宇宙风暴之后，迷失于混沌太空之中。财产损失和开发成本的打水漂就够让天空花园破产的了。

帮助我们是这位记录员多年来第一件有意义的服务。

“再说了，”她说。“我也很高兴能再次听到我曾祖母的声音，即使只是一个人工智能而已。”
texts.en:
With the new guide in our possession, restarting the habitat required little effort.

After the noise of activating machinery slowly died down, we decided to reach out to the record keeper once more to thank her.

She told us she had recovered some information on this station. Apparently it had been built over five centuries ago as a prototype, but was lost in the astrological chaos following a particularly nasty cosmic storm. The loss of property and development costs was enough to bankrupt Skygarden.

Helping us was the record keeper's first useful task in years.

"Besides," she said. "It was nice to hear my great-grandmother's voice on the line again, even it was just an AI."

texts.zh:
[owner.capital_scope.GetName]上自然发生的风暴向我们展现了大自然的洪荒之力——既有暴风雨的惊心动魄，也有毁灭之路通向的新生。

最近，全球各地的气象站都发现了一个不寻常的现象：一组超级风暴网络即将席卷全球。

我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]称之为“正义的机缘巧合”。这些罕见的风暴创造了完美的条件来让我们见证一些最激进的事情。
texts.en:
Naturally occurring storms on [owner.capital_scope.GetName] have shown us the awe-inspiring power of nature - both the thrilling intensity of the tempest and the renewal that follows its path of destruction.

Recently, weather stations across the planet have detected an extraordinary phenomenon: a network of superstorms poised to sweep across the world.

Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] call it 'righteous serendipity.' These rare tempests create the perfect conditions to witness something truly radical.

texts.zh:
我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]发现了风暴操纵的秘密。风暴能量预测已经突破了有史以来的一切记录。我们即将经受考验，并证明我们是最值得的。

特殊的建筑可以作为提高风暴的协调中心。[owner.capital_scope.GetName]上提升风暴的吸引力的建筑将加速我们向最终风暴的发展进程。
texts.en:
Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] have discovered the secrets of storm manipulation. The storm power projections are off the charts and we're all here for it. We will be tested and found most worthy.

Special buildings can serve as coordination centers for raising storms. A building on [owner.capital_scope.GetName] that increases storm attraction will accelerate our progress towards the ultimate storm.

texts.zh:
我们已经学会了如何启动[owner.capital_scope.GetName]的狂暴振动，以及将它们塑造成一种终极体验。但是我们必须决定哪一种风暴是最为壮观的。

通过向自然风暴中注入能量，我们可以为电力风暴创造出条件。

操纵行星核心可以改变[owner.capital_scope.GetName]的磁场方向，从而引起磁力风暴。

最后，通过在行星的特定位置逆转快子的极性，场的变化将可以用于产生引力风暴。
texts.en:
We have learned how to kickstart the tempestuous vibrations of [owner.capital_scope.GetName], shaping them into the ultimate experience. But we must decide which storm type is the most glorious.

By injecting energy into the natural storms, we can generate the conditions for electric storms.

Planetary core manipulation could reorient the magnetic field of [owner.capital_scope.GetName] to give rise to magnetic storms.

Finally, by reversing the tachyon polarity at specific planetary sites, field changes can produce gravity storms.

texts.zh:
我们已经学会了如何启动[owner.capital_scope.GetName]的狂暴振动，以及将它们塑造成一种终极体验。但是我们尚未决定哪一种风暴是最为壮观的。

通过向自然风暴中注入能量，我们可以为电力风暴创造出条件。

操纵行星核心可以改变[owner.capital_scope.GetName]的磁场方向，从而引起磁力风暴。

Planetary core manipulation could reorient the magnetic field of [owner.capital_scope.GetName] to give rise to magnetic storms.

texts.zh:
我们已经学会了如何启动[owner.capital_scope.GetName]的狂暴振动，以及将它们塑造成一种终极体验。但是在试图确定哪种风暴类型是最为壮观时，我们的价值判断进程陷入了递归循环。

通过向自然风暴中注入能量，我们可以为电力风暴创造出条件。

操纵行星核心可以改变[owner.capital_scope.GetName]的磁场方向，从而引起磁力风暴。

最后，通过在行星的特定位置逆转快子的极性，场的变化将可以用于产生引力风暴。
texts.en:
We have learned how to kickstart the tempestuous vibrations of [owner.capital_scope.GetName], shaping them into the ultimate experience. But our value judgment processes are stuck in recursive loops trying to determine which storm type is the most glorious.

By injecting energy into the natural storms, we can generate the conditions for electric storms.

Planetary core manipulation could reorient the magnetic field of [owner.capital_scope.GetName] to give rise to magnetic storms.

Finally, by reversing the tachyon polarity at specific planetary sites, field changes can produce gravity storms.

texts.zh:
天雷滚滚，电闪嘶鸣！

这些强大的放电过程不仅使行星表面带上电荷，而且也让我们感受到了真正的兴奋！虽然农业将遭受电力风暴的影响，但发电的潜力是不可否认的。
texts.en:
The sky rumbles. Lightning sizzles all around us!

Not only have these powerful discharges electrified the planet's surface, but they've left us truly amped! While farming will suffer from Electrical Storms, the potential for energy generation is undeniable.

texts.zh:
[owner.capital_scope.GetName]的磁场剧烈扭曲着，罗盘也随之狂乱起舞。

通过钻穿我们母星的地壳，我们将磁化物质直接注入地核，自然风暴放大了由此产生的磁场波动。这将妨碍能源生产，但会改善对新矿藏的探测。
texts.en:
Compasses spin wildly as the magnetic field of [owner.capital_scope.GetName] contorts itself.

By boring through the crust of our homeworld, we were able to inject magnetized matter directly into the core, and the natural storms amplified the resulting field fluctuations. This will hamper energy generation, but improve the detection of new mineral deposits.

texts.zh:
简单的运动在如今也是如此令人感到前所未有地兴奋！重力在难以察觉的瞬间增大减小。

分散在[owner.capital_scope.GetName]各地的粒子操作站逆转了快子的极性，将它们聚焦成噼啪作响的能量球。当光球球迅速消失时——[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]相信它们被送回了过去——引力波在各个方向荡漾。

由此产生的波动将使行星表面作业变得困难，但可以改善促进在轨空间站的岗位。
texts.en:
Never before has simple movement around been so exhilarating! Gravity increases and decreases without a moment's notice.

Particle manipulation sites scattered across [owner.capital_scope.GetName] reversed the polarity of tachyons, which focused them into crackling balls of energy. As the orbs quickly vanished - [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] believe they were sent backward in time - gravity waves rippled in all directions.

The resulting fluctuations will make working on the planet's surface harder, but could improve jobs on orbiting stations.

texts.zh:
[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]相信，我们用来刺激行星风暴的想法可以应用到更大的范围中去，现在整个恒星系都在狂暴的能量中旋转。

我们可以利用现成的知识和基础设施将其转化为一场电力风暴，也可以创造一些刺激的新东西。

引入特定的矿物将会增强风暴的磁场共振，而利用合金则会将其变为一个重力井。
texts.en:
Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] are convinced that the same ideas that we devoted to prodding the planetary storms could apply on a much larger scale, now that the whole system swirls with tempestuous energy.

We can use existing knowledge and infrastructure to transform it into an Electric Storm, or we create something new and exciting.

Introducing certain minerals would amplify the storm's magnetic resonance, while utilizing alloys would instead transform the storm into a gravity well.

texts.zh:
[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]相信，我们用来刺激行星风暴的想法可以应用到更大的范围中去，现在整个恒星系都在狂暴的能量中旋转。

我们可以利用现成的知识和基础设施将其转化为一场磁力风暴，也可以创造一些刺激的新东西。

充能恒星将会增强风暴的电力潜能，而利用合金则会将其变为一个重力井。
texts.en:
Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] are convinced that the same ideas that we devoted to prodding the planetary storms could apply on a much larger scale, now that the whole system swirls with tempestuous energy.

We can use existing knowledge and infrastructure to transform it into an Magnetic Storm, or we create something new and exciting.

Charging our sun would amplify the storm's electric potential, while utilizing alloys would instead transform the storm into a gravity well.

texts.zh:
[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]相信，我们用来刺激行星风暴的想法可以应用到更大的范围中去，现在整个恒星系都在狂暴的能量中旋转。

我们可以利用现成的知识和基础设施将其转化为一场重力风暴，也可以创造一些刺激的新东西。

引入特定的矿物将会增强风暴的磁场共振，而充能恒星将会增强风暴的电力潜能。
texts.en:
Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] are convinced that the same ideas that we devoted to prodding the planetary storms could apply on a much larger scale, now that the whole system swirls with tempestuous energy.

We can use existing knowledge and infrastructure to transform it into an Gravity Storm, or we create something new and exciting.

Introducing certain minerals would amplify the storm's magnetic resonance, while charging our sun would instead amplify the storm's electric potential.

texts.zh:
随着行星风暴的消散，[owner.capital_scope.GetName]上又出现了一个新的长期特征。风暴又一次带来了新生的机遇。

虽然这场局部风暴令人振奋，但是我们也只能畅想着一场真正的宇宙风暴的可能性。为什么它要花这么长时间？
texts.en:
When the planetary storm dispersed, a new lasting feature appeared on [owner.capital_scope.GetName]. Once again a storm has brought about change and rebirth.

As exhilarating as this local storm was, we can only imagine the possibilities of a true cosmic storm. Why does it take so long?

texts.zh:
我们可以加速[owner.capital_scope.GetStarName]周围巨大的宇宙风暴的涌现，但我们也必须扪心自问——我们真的准备好为此命悬一线了吗?

一支由[event_target:storm_scientist.GetName]带领的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]队伍可以研究这些早期的宇宙风暴模式，以发现操作它们生成的理想途径。

如果我们让[event_target:storm_commander.GetName]带领一支军队过去，他们能够引爆萌发中的风暴，让能量倾泻而下。

这支由领袖带领的队伍未必能安全回来。然而，他们也有成就一番伟大事业的可能！
texts.en:
We can hasten the appearance of the immense cosmic storm around [owner.capital_scope.GetStarName], but must ask ourselves - are we truly ready for the ride of our lives?

A team of [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] led by [event_target:storm_scientist.GetName] could research these early cosmic storm patterns to find optimal ways to manipulate their formation.

If we send the military led by [event_target:storm_commander.GetName], they can blast the burgeoning tempest and let the energy cascade.

This leader-led team risks an uncertain return. Then again, they may achieve something awesome!

If we send the military led by [event_target:storm_commander.GetName], they can blast the burgeoning tempest and let the energy cascade.

This leader-led team risks an uncertain return. Then again, they may achieve something awesome!

texts.zh:
我们现在能做的只有坐等宇宙风暴成型。

这种等待让人心急如焚，但也会让回报来得更猛烈一些。
texts.en:
All we can do now is wait for the cosmic storm to take shape.

The anticipation is almost unbearable, but will make the payoff even greater.

texts.zh:
起初只是宇宙织构中的一点波纹。能量在这里舞动、融合、碰撞。加一点奇异粒子、再一点质量，最后，附近一颗恒星的引力使这一切都倾泻到我们面前的这只野兽身上。

这个按照我们的意愿雕刻而来的自然和智慧的奇迹主宰了天空，并激起了狂热的兴奋。我们的领袖穿越风暴，激起了一阵狂热的兴奋。

我们做到了。只有我们做到了。让我们乘风破浪，享受一生难得的快感吧！
texts.en:
It began with a wrinkle in the cosmic fabric. Energies danced, merged, and collided. A hint of exotic particles, a dash of mass, and finally, the nascent storm that circles our star precipitated the beast before us.

Sculpted according to our wishes, this blessing of nature and ingenuity dominates the skies. Our leader riding out through the storm has whipped up a frenzy of excitement.

We did this. We alone did this. Let us ride this storm and embrace the thrill of a lifetime!

texts.zh:
起初只是宇宙织构中的一点波纹。能量在这里舞动、融合、碰撞。加一点奇异粒子、再一点质量，最后，附近一颗恒星的引力使这一切都倾泻到我们面前的这只野兽身上。

这个按照我们的意愿雕刻而来的自然和智慧的奇迹主宰了天空，并激起了狂热的兴奋。我们的领袖迷失在风暴中，但这是多么好的出路！

我们做到了。只有我们做到了。让我们乘风破浪，享受一生难得的快感吧！
texts.en:
It began with a wrinkle in the cosmic fabric. Energies danced, merged, and collided. A hint of exotic particles, a dash of mass, and finally, the nascent storm that circles our star precipitated the beast before us.

Sculpted according to our wishes, this blessing of nature and ingenuity dominates the skies. Our leader was lost in the storm, but what a way to go out!

We did this. We alone did this. Let us ride this storm and embrace the thrill of a lifetime!

texts.zh:
起初只是宇宙织构中的一点波纹。能量在这里舞动、融合、碰撞。加一点奇异粒子、再一点质量，最后，附近一颗恒星的引力使这一切都倾泻到我们面前的这只野兽身上。

这个按照我们的意愿雕刻而来的自然和智慧的奇迹主宰了天空，并激起了狂热的兴奋。我们已经等待了太久，但这一天终于到了。

我们做到了。只有我们做到了。让我们乘风破浪，享受一生难得的快感吧！
texts.en:
It began with a wrinkle in the cosmic fabric. Energies danced, merged, and collided. A hint of exotic particles, a dash of mass, and finally, the nascent storm that circles our star precipitated the beast before us.

Sculpted according to our wishes, this blessing of nature and ingenuity dominates the skies. We have waited long, but the day is finally here.

We did this. We alone did this. Let us ride this storm and embrace the thrill of a lifetime!

texts.zh:
宇宙的振动消失了，一如既往的壮举却没有像往常一般唤起人们的兴奋。我们毫无疑问完成了难以置信的事情，但人们都感到缺少了一些东西。我们祖先的成就，从水平和野心上都是传奇，向身后的我们投下了长长的阴影。

“这些斗争是最存在主义的！”我们的一位顶尖人士最近写道。“我们是在穿越了虚空之后，让自己陷入了空虚之中？”

焦虑是真实存在的，现在是采取行动的时候了。为了重新开始，我们回到起点：制定一系列挑战，以最大限度激发肾上腺素！
texts.en:
The cosmic vibrations are off, and the usual feats just don't evoke the same excitement they used to. There's no doubt we've accomplished incredible things, but there is a pervasive sense that something is missing. The achievements of our ancestors, legendary in their scope and ambition, cast a long shadow.

"These struggles are most existential!" one of our top minds recently wrote. "By traversing the void, have we opened a void in ourselves?"

The angst is real, and the time to act is now. To start fresh, we return to the beginning: a series of challenges custom designed to invoke maximum adrenaline!

texts.zh:
宇宙的振动消失了，一如既往的壮举却没有像往常一般唤起人们的兴奋。我们毫无疑问完成了难以置信的事情，但人们都感到缺少了一些东西。

我们被这样的问题所困扰着：我们真的知道自己是谁吗？我们的光辉岁月已经过去了吗？作为一个集体，我们有责任成为最好的自己。

焦虑是真实存在的，现在是采取行动的时候了。为了重新开始，我们回到起点：制定一系列挑战，以最大限度激发肾上腺素！
texts.en:
The cosmic vibrations are off, and the usual feats just don't evoke the same excitement they used to. There's no doubt we've accomplished incredible things, but there is a pervasive sense that something is missing.

We are plagued by questions: do we truly know who we are? Are our glory days behind us? As a collective, we have a responsibility to become the best version of ourselves.

The angst is real, and the time to act is now. To start fresh, we return to the beginning: a series of challenges custom designed to invoke maximum adrenaline!

texts.zh:
我们做到了！

我们的目标是追求纯粹的刺激，我们也已经迎接了每一个挑战。见证我们在往昔岁月里所取得的成就吧！

就像我们母星上的杰出先烈们一样，我们超越了自己的极限。

甚至，由于与自然的狂怒抗衡，我们还获得了对自身存在价值的难以置信的洞见。
texts.en:
We've done it!

Setting our sights on the pure pursuit of thrills, we've met every challenge. Witness what we've accomplished in the past years!

Like the most excellent pioneers of our homeworld, we have pushed ourselves beyond our limits.

Even better, due to our engagement with nature's fury, we have gained incredible insight into the meaning of our existence.

texts.zh:
我们的人民永无止境地追求刺激。每天我们都会发现不可思议的情景，面临更大的挑战，但[ruler.GetRegnalName]觉得我们还能更进一步：

“宇宙风暴的核心唯有潜能；那是真正的、最尖锐的前沿。它尖锐到足以斩断现状，释放出一生难得一次的快感。”

挑起一场真正史诗级风暴的时机已到，这将会是一场混乱的狂欢：浩宇风暴。现在只剩下两个小细节：一是要进行最后的研究，以敲定如何触发完美风暴，二是星系的其他人对我们是否应该这么做有什么看法。

实现这样的东西肯定会激起一些怨恨的。
texts.en:
Our people will never stop looking for a thrill. Every day we discover incredible situations and face greater challenges, but [ruler.GetRegnalName] thinks we can go even further:

"The core of a cosmic storm is pure potential; the true, bleeding edge. An edge sharp enough to sever the status-quo and unleash the rush of a lifetime."

The time is ripe to provoke a storm of truly epic proportions, a nexus of joyous pandemonium: The Big One. Only two minor details remain: a final study to determine exactly how to invoke the perfect storm, and the opinion of the rest of the galaxy should we choose to do so.

Bringing something like this into being is sure to stir up some resentment.

texts.zh:
暗物质独一无二的性质使其成为浩宇风暴的完美导火索。我们将向环绕首都恒星系的太空织构注入这种难以捉摸的物质，等待风暴的第一波涟漪出现。

然而，这件事已经引起了多余的关注：邻国们开始抗议了。“不是谁都跟我们一样兴高采烈地随风逐浪，”我们一位[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]埋怨道。
texts.en:
The unique properties of Dark Matter make it the perfect thing to stir up The Big One. We will inject this elusive material into the spatial fabric surrounding our capital system and wait for the first ripples of the storm to appear.

However, this has already attracted some unwanted attention: our neighbors have begun to protest. "Not everyone is as stoked as us to ride this particular wave," complained one of our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural].

label.en: We need to save up some resources.

texts.zh:
难以置信！即将来临的风暴的萌动已经能感觉到了。我们[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]的还在努力着，但使我们离引发浩宇风暴又近了一步。

然而，我们的邻国并不太满意。他们声称我们在胡搞我们不可能理解的力量，这已经影响了我们间的关系。
texts.en:
Incredible! The nascent vibrations of the coming storm are already being felt. The work of our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] is ongoing, but we are now one step closer to summoning The Big One.

However, our neighbors are less pleased. They claim we're meddling with powers we cannot possibly comprehend, and this has already affected our relations.

texts.zh:
数据已然明晰：这场风暴可谓种瓜得瓜，种豆得豆。既是如此，若是我们给风暴饲喂合适类型的资源，它就能拥有任何一种风暴的特性，并达到史诗般的规模。

星系的住民们再次表达了担忧，但世纪之旅已指日可待。该穷尽国力饲育风暴了！
texts.en:
The data is clear: whatever we put into this storm, something similar will come out of it. Ergo, if we feed it the right type of resources, then it will take on properties - and epic proportions- of every type of storm.

The people of the galaxy continue to express concern, but the ride of the century is just waiting to be born. Let us feed it what we have!

texts.zh: 若是我们想要创造一场史诗般的风暴，就必须为这场初生的风暴提供种种养分。这项惊人的壮举需要我们手头上一组特定的资源。
texts.en: We must provide the nascent storm a wide variety of nourishment if we wish to create a storm of epic proportions. This amazing feat requires a specific sampling of resources at our disposal.

texts.zh:
兴奋之情溢于言表。前方的道路越发清晰：前进，前进，向着目标前进。让我们与宇宙的狂热融为一体！万事俱备，只需稍加一把推手，浩宇风暴就要来临。

我们的邻国已然怒不可遏，声称我们所谓的“枢纽风暴”将对星系造成巨大的破坏。但我们真要让这些扫兴的家伙毁掉这一史诗般的项目吗？抉择的时刻到了。
texts.en:
The excitement is palpable. The path ahead grows clear: push further, push harder, push through. Let us become one with cosmic frenzy itself! Everything is now ready for the Big One. We just need to give one small push.

Our neighbors are already beyond livid, claiming that our so-called 'Nexus Storm' will wreak havoc on the galaxy. But are we really going to let these killjoys derail a project of such epic proportions? The time to choose is now.

label.zh: 浩宇风暴是我们的终极宿命！
label.en: The Big One is our ultimate destiny!

label.zh: 算了，我们可以做得更好！
label.en: No, we are better than this!

texts.zh:
我们站在新体验的悬崖边。终极灾难的时刻到了。我们的风暴骑士无所畏惧，从没有他们不肯接受的挑战。让星系听见我们的名字吧！

让整个星系开开眼界！
texts.en:
Here we are - at the precipice of a new experience. The time of ultimate calamity has arrived. There is nothing our Storm Riders won't face. No challenge we will ever deny.

Let the galaxy witness!

texts.zh:
我们学到了很多。终于知道星系不是玩物，而是一场有待体验的冒险。

[ruler.GetRegnalName]说得好：“人生从不缺刺激。我们永远不会停止追求下一个挑战，但我们必须怀着敬意。与星系及其居民和谐共处是我们的准则。我们选择了这么做，这才是我们真正的意义所在。”
texts.en:
We have learned much. Now we understand that the galaxy is not a toy to be played with, but an adventure to be experienced.

[ruler.GetRegnalName] said it best: "In this life, there are no shortages of thrills. We'll never stop seeking the next challenge, but we must do so with respect. This is what we have chosen. This is who we are truly meant to be.

title.zh: 挑战成功：在风暴内战胜一支舰队
title.en: Challenge Completed: Defeat a Fleet Inside a Storm

texts.zh:
我们到达了新高度、检验了新极限！这正是那种让人心潮澎湃的事情，我们完成了挑战！

那支舰队连一战的机会都没有。还有谁？
texts.en:
New heights were reached and limits have been shredded! Just the thing to get the emotions firing. We have completed the trial!

That fleet never had any fighting chance. Who dares challenge us next?

title.zh: 挑战成功：探索星系的边缘
title.en: Challenge Completed: Explore the Edge of the Galaxy

texts.zh:
我们到达了新高度、检验了新极限！这正是那种让人心潮澎湃的事情，我们完成了挑战！

这个星系可以给我们这么多！永远不会无聊，永远也不用停步。继续下一个挑战！
texts.en:
New heights were reached and limits have been shredded! Just the thing to get the emotions firing. We have completed the trial!

The galaxy has so much to offer! There's never a dull moment, and there's no sense stopping now. Onward to the next challenge!

texts.zh:
我们到达了新高度、检验了新极限！这正是那种让人心潮澎湃的事情，我们完成了挑战！

钻研远古的秘密、发掘埋藏的宝藏总是这么令人兴奋。谁知道外面的世界还有什么等着我们去发现呢?
texts.en:
New heights were reached and limits have been shredded! Just the thing to get the emotions firing. We have completed the trial!

Delving into ancient secrets and unearthing buried treasure is always a thrill. Who knows what's still out there, just waiting to be found?

texts.zh:
我们到达了新高度、检验了新极限！这正是那种让人心潮澎湃的事情，我们完成了挑战！

我们的风暴骑士发回的报告中只有喜悦的欢呼声。宇宙风暴是一种全新档次的刺激！
texts.en:
New heights were reached and limits have been shredded! Just the thing to get the emotions firing. We have completed the trial!

Our Storm Rider reported back with nothing but exultant cheers. The cosmic storms are a whole new level of thrill!

texts.zh:
我们到达了新高度、检验了新极限！这正是那种让人心潮澎湃的事情，我们完成了挑战！

我们感觉充满了喜悦。宇宙风暴带来了全新档次的刺激。
texts.en:
New heights were reached and limits have been shredded! Just the thing to get the emotions firing. We have completed the trial!

We feel filled with exultation. The cosmic storms bring excitement to a whole new level.

texts.zh:
我们到达了新高度、检验了新极限！这正是那种让人心潮澎湃的事情，我们完成了挑战！

这场风暴径直穿过了他们的空间，在同等程度上传播了兴奋和混沌！为邻居们提供了如此令人难以置信的体验，这下我们可以放心了。

他们现在可能不感激，但最终会感谢我们的。
texts.en:
New heights were reached and limits have been shredded! Just the thing to get the emotions firing. We have completed the trial!

That storm tore right through their space, spreading thrills and disarray in equal measure! We can rest easy knowing we provided our neighbors with such an incredible experience

They may not appreciate it now, but they'll thank us eventually.

texts.zh:
我们到达了新高度、检验了新极限！这正是那种让人心潮澎湃的事情，我们完成了挑战！

强大的风暴呼唤他的名字，他也欣喜地回应。致敬风暴骑士，你是绝对的传奇！愿你通往彼岸的旅程如同你的退场一样壮丽。
texts.en:
New heights were reached and limits have been shredded! Just the thing to get the emotions firing. We have completed the trial!

The great storm called their name and they answered with jubilation. Hail Storm Rider, you absolute legend! May your journey to the great beyond be as epic as your exit.

texts.zh:
我们到达了新高度、检验了新极限！这正是那种让人心潮澎湃的事情，我们完成了挑战！

强大的风暴呼唤我们的一部分加入它的欢腾肆虐。从未有过对失去节点感觉如此有意义和充满活力！这一史诗般的经历将在未来许多年里定义我们是谁。
texts.en:
New heights were reached and limits have been shredded! Just the thing to get the emotions firing. We have completed the trial!

The great storm has called a part of ourself to join it in jubilant carnage. Losing a node has never felt so meaningful and invigorating! This epic experience will define our species for many years to come.

texts.zh:
我们到达了新高度、检验了新极限！这正是那种让人心潮澎湃的事情，我们完成了挑战！

大风暴呼唤着他，他也欢欣鼓舞地回应着。向风暴骑士致敬，您绝对是个传奇!
texts.en:
New heights were reached and limits have been shredded! Just the thing to get the emotions firing. We have completed the trial!

The great storm called their name and they answered with jubilation. Hail Storm Rider, you absolute legend!

texts.zh:
我们到达了新高度、检验了新极限！这正是那种让人心潮澎湃的事情，我们完成了挑战！

大风暴召唤了我们的一部分加入它的欢腾屠杀。从来没有一次近乎失去一个节点的感觉是如此地有意义，令我们充满活力！这一史诗般的经历将在未来的日子里告诉我们自己是谁。
texts.en:
New heights were reached and limits have been shredded! Just the thing to get the emotions firing. We have completed the trial!

The great storm has called a part of ourself to join it in jubilant carnage. Nearly losing a node has never felt so meaningful and invigorating! This epic experience will define our species for many years to come.

texts.zh: 席卷而过的宇宙风暴留下了一份奇怪的礼物：一座属于老旧居住站系统的轨道复合体。登陆之后有可能加以激活。
texts.en: The passing cosmic storm left behind a curious present: an orbital complex from an old habitat system. Boarding may allow us to reactivate it.

sections.zh: 席卷而过的宇宙风暴留下了一份奇怪的礼物：一座属于老旧居住站系统的轨道复合体。登陆之后有可能加以激活。
sections.en: The passing cosmic storm left behind a curious present: an orbital complex from an old habitat system. Boarding may allow us to reactivate it.

texts.zh: 为了再创新高，感受欢愉以及挑战我们的极限，我们现在开始一系列试炼。欢乐时间到！
texts.en: To reach new heights, to know joy and to test our limits, we now embark on a series of trials. Let the fun begin!

texts.zh: 我们一直在挑战极限。在前人事迹的鼓舞下，我们现在有机会塑造自己梦想的风暴。
texts.en: We have always pushed the limits. Inspired by the deeds of our predecessors, we now have the chance to sculpt the storm of our dreams.

texts.zh: [owner.capital_scope.GetName]的极端天气揭示了风暴中令人振奋的力量。如果我们掌握了对行星天气的控制，我们就可以在宇宙尺度上利用这些知识。建造风暴吸引建筑将会加速我们追寻终极风暴的进程。
texts.en: Intense weather on [owner.capital_scope.GetName] has revealed the exhilarating power of storms. If we master the control of planetary weather, we could harness that knowledge on a cosmic scale. Constructing storm attraction buildings will accelerate our progress towards the ultimate storm.

texts.zh: 这场在[Owner.Capital.GetName]的千载难逢的风暴具有一种非常适合调制的独特性质。但首先我们必须加深对其构成的理解。谁知道我们会给生活带来什么奇妙的东西呢？
texts.en: This once-in-a-lifetime storm system on [Owner.Capital.GetName] has special properties that make it ripe for modulation. But first, we'll need to better understand its underlying composition. Who knows what brilliant oddity we may bring to life?

texts.zh: 我们有培植风暴的技术，附近却没有初生的风暴。我们需要研究如何播种出一个可以培植的风暴。
texts.en: We have the technology, but without a nascent storm in the vicinity, we will need to investigate how to seed a storm we can sculpt.

texts.zh: 小心地将暗物质注入太空织构就可以在这个恒星系中激起可塑的风暴。
texts.en: By carefully injecting Dark Matter into the spatial fabric, a malleable storm will be provoked within this system.

texts.zh: 我们如今知晓宇宙风暴能靠提供正确的饮食来操控。为了饲育这场风暴，我们需要特定的资源。
texts.en: We now know that a cosmic storm can be manipulated by feeding it the correct diet. To feed this one, we require a certain sampling.

texts.zh: 创造一场完美的风暴需要一组精心调配的资源。
texts.en: Creating the perfect storm will require a carefully measured sampling of resources.

texts.zh: 我们在[solar_system.GetName]星系发现了被宇宙风暴夹带着穿越星系的某种未知生物的遗骸。对待这具遗骸进行法医鉴定可以揭示更多信息。
texts.en: We have encountered the remains of an unknown creature in the [solar_system.GetName] system dragged across the galaxy by a cosmic storm. Forensic dissection of the corpse should reveal more information.

texts.zh: 三只被宇宙风暴从鲸群中带丢的缇扬奇幼崽在[this.solar_system.GetName]星系游荡。我们可以通过放大它们的叫声来帮助它们把鲸群吸引到这个星系中来帮助它们重聚。
texts.en: Three Tiyanki calves are lost and wandering the [this.solar_system.GetName] system, separated from their pod by a cosmic storm. We can help reunite them with their pod by boosting their cries to attract the rest of their pod to the system.
